title: Nobody 無名の者
author: No Name
content: 囲まれた土壌は私の庭です。私の意識の中では、私はその独裁者です――どの植物を守り、どの植物を取り除くかを決定します。私にとって望ましくない植物は「雑草」と呼ばれます。その定義が形成された瞬間から、これらの「雑草」と私は一生にわたる闘いを始め、この土地を需要の競争の場や美的な戦場に変えてしまいます。 これらの「雑草」はそれぞれに独自の名前を持っていますが、その名前はほとんど知られず、また誰も関心を持ちません。そのため、彼らは総じて「雑草」と呼ばれ、無名の存在，無名の者になるのです。 The fenced soil is my garden. In my consciousness, I am its dictator - deciding which plants to protect and which ones to remove. Those unwelcome plants are what I call "weeds." From the moment of their definition, these "weeds" have begun a lifelong struggle with me, turning this plot of land into a competitive ground for needs and a battlefield for aesthetics. These "weeds" each have their own names, but those names are hardly known or cared about by anyone. They are collectively referred to as "weeds," becoming the nameless ones, the nobodies. Nobody 無名の者 Li Li 1982, Born in Chongqing, China 2001-2005, Study oil painting in Sichuan Fine Art Institute, Chongqing, China 2005-2008, Work as an artist 2008-2020, Work as curator and assistant curator in art spaces in Chongqing, China Solo Exhibition: 2016 Simmering, Schauraum, Vienna, Austria Selected Group Exhibitions: 2015 Cloud Laboratory, Work as a team member of DD, LP Art Space, Chongqing, China I Start Art Festival, Chengdu, China 2014 Fiction, Organhaus, Chongqing, China Fiction, Gallery Soap, Kitakyushu, Japan 2012 Reality And The Aesthetic Regime Of Art, WJ Commune, Chongqing, China 2010 Summer Show, Eli Klein Fine Art, New York 2008 Marginality, J Chen Gallery, Taipei, Taiwan CARTOON, Thomas Cohn Gallery, Sao Paulo, Brazil 2007 CARTOON, Chinese Contemporary Gallery, New York 3rd Guiyang Art Biennale Exhibition, Word of Mouth from Four Corners, Guiyang Art Museum, Guiyang CHANYU AND LILI, Gallery “J·Chen”, Taipei, Taiwan 2006 Our Toys Our Dream Our Childhood, 82 Republic, Hong Kong Replacement, Chinese Contemporary Gallery, Beijing 2005 Archaeology of The Future, The Second Triennial Of Chinese Art, Nanjing Red Classic Art Gallery, The Nanjing Museum, Yangzi Evening Paper, Nanjing Artist in Residence: 2013 Art Master, St. Moritz, Swiss 2014 Gallery Soap, Kitakyushu, Japan 2016 SCHAURAUM, Vienna, Austria SCHAURAUM Projects as Curator and Organizer: 2017 Curated Frank Havermans’s solo exhibition Infra, Galaxy Museum of Contemporary Art, Chongqing, China 2017 Organized workshop Winter in Subtropical Chongqing, with Madlen Kobi and Verena Zimmermann, Organhaus, Chongqing, China Email: mijimi227@gmail.com Website: www.mijilili.weebly.com
